description: Fires when the opponent owns the column-1 cells at rows 2 and 3 (third and fourth from the bottom) and I have not capped them at row 4. Strongest when they own rows 2-4 with row 5 empty: a vertical three threatening to win atop column 1. The same stack in other columns, a low three (rows 0-2), or stones only at rows 3-5 do not fire.
effect: Pushes the model toward playing column 1 (blocking/capping the stack): forcing it high raises column 1 by about 7-21 points; zeroing it changes moves by under 5 points.
notes: Best dev F1 0.561 (P 0.64, R 0.50, AUROC 0.75), sim share of ceiling 0.56 (p3). Alternatives: any stack incl. capped F1 0.506; top-run-of-theirs height 4-5 F1 0.389. Clean minimal pairs strongly support the column-1 (2,1)+(3,1) cell detector, perspective-independent (me first or second). Exceptions: capped or full columns sometimes still fire depending on surrounding stones; many near-threshold firings have no column-1 pattern. Synthesis up to 15.2 (vs dev max 10.2) by adding extra must-blocks for them alongside the column-1 three.
